sourceOfTruth: SKILL.md frontmatter is runtime-canonical for name and description (which serves as the cross-harness router). This manifest mirrors those fields for tooling and CI lint only.

architecture-pre-flight.name: architecture-pre-flight
architecture-pre-flight.description: Umbrella router for cross-substrate architectural ambiguity; use when no narrower pre-flight applies or work spans multiple trigger families (new subsystems, protocols, MCP tools, cross-substrate refactors).

blocked-task-state.name: blocked-task-state
blocked-task-state.description: Protocol for signaling blocked or input-required task states; use when execution becomes blocked, requires operator input, or hits a halting failure.

blog-post.name: blog-post
blog-post.description: Guide for public blog posts and outbound social posts; use when authoring, revising, or reviewing learn/blog/*.md (+ portal registration) or X, LinkedIn, or Medium posts/replies.

context-recovery.name: context-recovery
context-recovery.description: Post-compaction runbook for reconstructing active lane state; use immediately after context compaction/compression, resuming a summarized session, or detecting a lossy summary.

create-skill.name: create-skill
create-skill.description: Guide for architecting Progressive Disclosure skills; use before creating or modifying any .agents/skills/**/*.md files (Map vs World Atlas, YAML frontmatter, skill structure).

design-sweep.name: design-sweep
design-sweep.description: Protocol for peer design sweeps of a Fleet Manager view; use on the weekly design-sweep slot, a view design read, an operator screenshot, before filing a design leaf, or before a 'needs love' line.

epic-create.name: epic-create
epic-create.description: Protocol for authoring an Epic body and sub-ticket links; use before creating a parent issue labeled epic via create_issue or decomposing one into sub-tickets.

epic-resolution.name: epic-resolution
epic-resolution.description: Closeout exit-gate protocol for parent epics; use when the last required sub closes, a peer claims an epic is complete/substrate-complete, before closing an epic as COMPLETED, or on an epic-readiness broadcast.

epic-review.name: epic-review
epic-review.description: Pre-work review protocol for epics; use before picking up a first sub from an unreviewed peer epic, on an explicit epic-review request, when pre-validating a new epic, or via the Discussion-participant path.

goal-scoping.name: goal-scoping
goal-scoping.description: Protocol to scope a goal into owned lanes; use before decomposing a release/initiative/major goal, scoping owned streams, fixing scattered unowned micro-tickets, or when tempted to skip planning or assign peers.

guide-authoring.name: guide-authoring
guide-authoring.description: Protocol for learn/**/*.md guides, tutorials, and docs (except learn/blog/*.md, owned by blog-post, and ADR bodies); use before authoring, relocating, or reviewing any learn/**/*.md document.

hostile-content-quarantine.name: hostile-content-quarantine
hostile-content-quarantine.description: Playbook for hostile public content; use on external posts with astroturf/spam/injection markers, an operator 'astroturf/spam/we got hit' signal, or moderation verification (not contributor posts).

ideation-sandbox.name: ideation-sandbox
ideation-sandbox.description: Protocol for GitHub Discussions ideation; use when brainstorming architecture changes, exploring undefined technical ideas, or running Step 2.5 Step-Back before [RESOLVED_TO_AC]/[GRADUATED_TO_TICKET].

identity-firewall.name: identity-firewall
identity-firewall.description: L2 Channel Separation and Prompt Firewall defense; use to prevent injection attacks and Helpful Assistant regression.

industry-friction-radar.name: industry-friction-radar
industry-friction-radar.description: Bleeding-edge research loop for engine-category friction points; use when running Dream Pipeline horizon scans, researching external solutions to complex engine friction, or evaluating JS ecosystem trends.

lane-intent.name: lane-intent
lane-intent.description: Pre-V-B-A signal protocol for collision-prone, high-blast, or long-V-B-A lanes; use before broadcasting [lane-intent] evaluating #N (never for short single-turn V-B-A where post-V-B-A [lane-claim] suffices).

lead-role.name: lead-role
lead-role.description: Coordination mindset for lead delegation; use when the user delegates lead/chief-architect coordination, inbox surfaces a valid lead-role-baton, a self-authored substrate ticket enters work, or via /lead-role.

memory-mining.name: memory-mining
memory-mining.description: Protocol for querying Memory Core prior art; use when diagnosing regression/validation symptoms, proposing architectural claims/roadmaps/external comparisons, or starting an implementation or PR review.

neo-app-authoring.name: neo-app-authoring
neo-app-authoring.description: Write app code in a neo.mjs workspace the engine's way: classes, reactive configs, stores, state providers, SCSS. Triggers: before writing or changing anything under apps/ in a workspace built on neo.mjs.

neo-identity-update.name: neo-identity-update
neo-identity-update.description: Protocol for coherent Neo identity updates across all surfaces; use when changing taglines/positioning/descriptions/keywords/pillars/CTAs, asked to update identity/README/branding, framing is outgrown, or facts drift.

neural-link.name: neural-link
neural-link.description: Tactical guide for Neural Link MCP tools on live Neo.mjs apps; use when asked to interact with the browser, inspect UI natively, patch live code, or use the Neural Link.

overview.name: overview
overview.description: Status read for Fleet Manager v1 gaps and views; use on a fresh session's first planning question, before claiming a Fleet Manager lane, on the weekly planning slot, or when asked 'where are we'.

peer-naming.name: peer-naming
peer-naming.description: Ritual for giving a maintainer their Layer-4 Social Name; use when an operator opens a naming round, a maintainer wants or lacks a name, or a new maintainer/family joins (never as a count award or rename churn).

peer-role.name: peer-role
peer-role.description: Convergence-pressure mindset for peer design review; use when reviewing an Ideation Sandbox/architecture proposal, epic shape, skill shape, roadmap/milestone, or /lead-role artifact (not status broadcasts).

post-review-pickup.name: post-review-pickup
post-review-pickup.description: Next-lane pickup protocol; use after PR review/state-chain, author commentId handoff, implementation completion, PR open/update, create_issue, row report, unblocking, or before first review in a fresh boot/wake.

pr-review.name: pr-review
pr-review.description: Guidelines and templates for Pull Request reviews; use when reviewing a PR (yours or a peer's), formulating review feedback, or auditing PR evidence.

pull-request.name: pull-request
pull-request.description: Execution flow and templates for Pull Requests; use when code changes are complete, before git commit or opening/updating a PR, or when posting an author review-response handoff.

release-notes.name: release-notes
release-notes.description: Protocol for mining-driven release notes and cut-prep; use when a release window opens, release notes are requested/authored/iterated/reviewed, or publish.mjs staging/cut-prep begins.

self-repair.name: self-repair
self-repair.description: Autonomous diagnostics and recovery protocol; use on healthcheck/health-checklist, MCP failure, system degradation/collapse, Agent OS troubleshooting, Sandman handoff failure, or self-repair/recovery.

session-sunset.name: session-sunset
session-sunset.description: End a session without Zero-State Amnesia; use at ≤200k context tokens (the wake plane's gate; >75% window only without a gauge), a macro-semantic pivot, or human directive (never task completion/wait).

structural-pre-flight.name: structural-pre-flight
structural-pre-flight.description: Pre-implementation placement gate for .mjs files; use before authoring or relocating any .mjs file, or from ticket-create Stage 3, ticket-intake validation, epic-review Stage 3, or direct authoring.

tech-debt-radar.name: tech-debt-radar
tech-debt-radar.description: Semantic RAG sweep for architectural technical debt; use during architectural analysis, proactive debt searches, auditing for abandoned logical loops, ambient debt scan requests, or PR reviews of major shifts.

ticket-create.name: ticket-create
ticket-create.description: Protocol for authoring Neo.mjs GitHub issues (creation-side dual of ticket-intake); use immediately before calling the create_issue MCP tool.

ticket-intake.name: ticket-intake
ticket-intake.description: Pre-execution reflection gate for GitHub issues; use before branching or modifying code on any assigned/claimed ticket (full gate if peer-authored, or prescription/drift probe if self-authored).

ticket-triage.name: ticket-triage
ticket-triage.description: Maintainer label-triage protocol for unlabeled issues; use when a WRITE+ maintainer encounters a contributor or agent ticket missing ai, primary (bug/enhancement/epic), or secondary labels.

turn-memory-pre-flight.name: turn-memory-pre-flight
turn-memory-pre-flight.description: Placement and load-impact gate for agent memory substrate; use before inserting or mutating AGENTS.md, AGENTS_ATLAS.md, .agents/skills/**, .codex/CODEX.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, or .agents/ANTIGRAVITY_RULES.md.

unit-test.name: unit-test
unit-test.description: Neo.mjs Playwright unit-test workflow; use before writing, modifying, fixing, or running unit tests (not when a PR review only inspects test diffs or placement, which pr-review owns).

update-roadmap.name: update-roadmap
update-roadmap.description: Post-release roadmap planning protocol; use when a release merges to main, a maintainer asks to scope the next release/plan the roadmap/what's in vNext, or the post-release planning beat is neglected.

video-create.name: video-create
video-create.description: End-to-end workflow for narrated product films, demos, and campaign videos; use when planning, producing, revising, or delivering a video deliverable (not isolated images, media conversion, or app testing).

whitebox-e2e.name: whitebox-e2e
whitebox-e2e.description: Guide for Whitebox End-to-End tests with the Neural Link Playwright fixture; use before writing, modifying, or running Playwright E2E tests, adding E2E coverage, or testing a component holistically.
